senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Shaking, tremulous.
2 Rolling, tossing.
3 Agitated, alarmed.
4 Fickle, unsteady.
5 Desiring, wishing, cupidinous.
6 Greedy.
f. (-ला)
1 The tongue.
2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, or the goddess of wealth and fortune.
3 A species of the Śarkarī metre.
E.
लोड to be frantic, अच् aff.

mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं)
Greedy, insatiable.
E.
लोल, and जिह्वा the tongue.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Rolling, tossing, rolling on the ground.
E.
लोड to be frantic, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः-क्षी-क्षि)
Having a rolling eye.
E.
लोल, and अक्षि the eye; also लोलचक्षुस्, लोलनयन, लोललोचन, लोलनेत्र, and the like.

f. (-का)
A sort of dock or sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, tremulous, trembling.
E.
लुल to agitate, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Very desirous or covetous, wishing, longing for, greedy, insatiable.
E.
लुप to desire, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Very cupidinous, excessively desirous, very covetous or greedy.
E.
लुभ to desire or covet, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Cutting much or often.
E.
लू to cut, freq. v., aff. अच्.

f. (-या)
Determination to cut.
E.
लू to cut, intensitive v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (वान्-वती-वत्)
Resolved to cut or cut off.
E.
लोलूया, and मतुप् aff.
